question.prompt: In a Cartesian coordinate system, point \(B(-3,4)\) is rotated clockwise through \(90^\circ\) about the origin O to obtain B′. Find the coordinates of B′. (Give the x-coordinate followed by the y-coordinate, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: Rotating a point \((x,y)\) clockwise through \(90^\circ\) about the origin gives \((y,-x)\), so the coordinates of B′ are \((4,3)\).
solutions.title: Apply the clockwise quarter-turn coordinate rule
